deliberate_overlap: I1/I2/I7 all attack the combine and are mutually reinforcing or exclusive; I3 lives inside the finalize that I1 relocates (if I1 wins, I3 multiplies); I5/I6 both restructure compute phases. Resolved at aggregation, never among subagents.
not_floated: input read (at the DRAM roofline per /perf-ceiling-dm reasoning: 563KB/500GB/s = 1.1us vs 1011ns measured) and any precision-knob change (fp32_dest_acc_en / math_fidelity / dtypes are the user contract)

I1_allgather_combine.ns: focus group 11x10 rows_t=1: baseline 3990-4196 vs allgather 21874 (5.3x slower); flat_allgather 162753 (42x)
I1_allgather_combine.mechanism: multicasts into the same rectangle DO NOT overlap: ~13-18ns per destination per broadcast, additive across senders. An S-sender all-gather costs S broadcasts; the baseline already uses the minimum (1).
side_findings: sum_mcast (same tree, broadcast the SUM, every core finalizes): flat on every REACHABLE geometry (single-block decode, wshard 8x1/7x4, bshard 8-core groups), 1.12x at 4 blocks / 1.17x at 16 blocks on a 110-core two-stage box — a geometry the selection function never produces (1 tile-row => 1 block) => NULL in domain

mcast_pipe PRE_HANDSHAKE ack costs ~520ns per block (3990 -> 3470 = 13pct on the focus geometry) and protects nothing when the per-core assignment is ONE block; needs host-init of ReceiverPipe data_ready to be safe => ROUND-2 LEAD, not graduated

I2_colvalid_payload.domain: everywhere, NO exceptions; poison-tested (NaN/-Inf into faces 1/3) PCC unchanged => no zero-fill needed; both stat dtypes (bf16 and fp32) covered since the payload derives from get_tile_size(cb_stat_gather)

I3_cskip_finalize.precision: BIT-EXACT on column 0 in both fp32_dest_acc_en legs over 11 magnitudes + hostile garbage in cols 1-31
I3_cskip_finalize.domain: everywhere incl. fp32 stat tiles; exceptions: Quasar (no _calculate_sqrt_body_ there; op has no Quasar path) and cskip_FUSED regresses at N=1 (0.84x) so only the PAIR form graduates

ns.focus_regime_110c_C2: 3007 -> 2779 (1.082x) by moving BOTH constants to the writer (reorder-within-reader only 2874)

I4_scaler_offpath.domain: everywhere; deferring the MASK inside the reader starves mask_tail_block (+400ns) which is why the writer is the answer; cb_scaler/cb_wmask are never aliased so R3 gamma-reorder failure mode cannot recur

I5_apply_fusion.ns: focus (1,3) baseline 566 vs fused_rstd 642 (1.13x slower); flat at (3,32) and (1,112); fused_gamma and fused_sfpu much worse
I5_apply_fusion.mechanism: DestReuseBinary has no BroadcastDim so the fused chain holds two different math-MOP element types => chain_math_mop_uniform false => hoist_math false => both elements re-emit init + srcA/srcB reconfig once per block iteration (~195ns). Raw LLK cannot remove it (same MOP registers).
I5_apply_fusion.refuted: R4 ground (ii) is FALSE: dest-reuse costs zero precision at bf16 AND fp32/HiFi4, so no dtype gate was ever needed
side_findings: output CB lifecycle (bulk Upfront/AtEnd instead of per-tile) 566->479 at (1,3) = 1.18x, and DEST-lane blocking a further 1.1-1.25x, up to 1.60x combined at (16,4) / 1.58x at (1,112) — but bulk output delays the writer until the whole block is packed, and the integration-safe PerChunk form was NOT measured => ROUND-2 LEAD
helper bug: DestReuseBinary is INCORRECT at blk==8 with HiFi2/fp32_dest_acc=False (pcc 0.982, structurally-invalid rows leak in); blk<=6 exact
helper bug: block_size>1 with ReservePolicy::PerTile HANGS (elem_apply_pack reserves one page per block iteration but packs inner_count tiles; no static_assert)

I6_sumsq_reduce_merge.mechanism: the SFPU within-tile collapse costs +115ns/tile-row MORE than the pack+unpack+FPU-matmul-reduce it deletes, and the 1/W multiply (free inside the FPU reduce scaler) costs another +60-107ns. Merge saves only ~75-90ns per BLOCK (one phase boundary). Break-even needs <1 tile-row per block => none.
side_findings: baseline_onechain: ONE eltwise_chain over the whole hidden slice instead of one per chunk => 1.436x on the CHUNKED geometry, flat (0.992-1.001x) in all five other regimes, better PCC, and cb_stat_sq shrinks from rows_t*NUM_CHUNKS to rows_t tiles. Inexpressible for IS_RM_IN (chunk-major block). MEASURED WIN, graduation deferred to round 2: it changes _stat_cols, which the L1 residency solve consumes, so it re-opens WC selection on exactly the L1-critical chunked cells

baseline_norecfg (DataFormatReconfig::Disabled at the stat phase boundary): 1.073x per-block / 1.10x one-shot on the focus shape, but only correct at fp32_dest_acc_en=False (at True the stat CBs are fp32 while the input is bf16, so the unpacker formats DO change) => a real dual-path, reasoned not measured at True => ROUND-2 LEAD
mul_unary_tile hardcodes VectorMode::RC; scoping to ::C on a column-0-valid tile is 60 vs 107 ns at identical precision
